Adam Goldstein, founder and CEO of electric aircraft company Archer, discusses its acquisition of three Boeing businesses and the resulting strategic partnership. He explains how the deal combines Archer’s commercialization focus with Boeing’s autonomous aviation technologies, accelerating advanced air mobility development ahead of Archer’s planned role at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Brian Yutko is the Chief Technology Officer of Boeing, where he leads the company's technology strategy and the development of next-generation commercial aircraft. Previously the CEO of Wisk Aero, he has spent his career advancing autonomous flight, advanced air mobility, and aerospace innovation, with earlier leadership roles at Aurora Flight Sciences and Boeing's future aircraft programs.
